name: Baltrice
description: Tezzeret's second in command, who tortured Jace and later assisted Jace.

description_citations.text: "Tezzeret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret returns to Victis and faces Jace and Baltrice, leaving Jace with a magic-blocking device; Baltrice joins Tezzeret to save Jace.
timeline.quote: Baltrice then accompanies Tezzeret on his mission because she wants to save Jace.

citation.text: "Test of Metal", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas arrives, then Baltrice with the disabled Jace; Bolas reads their minds with a Memory Syphon and suspends them.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas reads both of their minds using a Memory Syphon, then suspends them.

citation.text: "Test of Metal", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret frees Liliana from her pact, gives Baltrice sangrite and a necklace, and Baltrice falls out with Jace; Jace leaves alive.
timeline.quote: He gives Liliana freedom from her blood-signed pact with Nicol Bolas.

citation.text: "Test of Metal", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret agrees to Sharuum's proposal and receives two riddles from Crucius.

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Test of Metal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the Metal Island Tezzeret engineers a fight in which Bolas is weakened and leaves him trapped.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret himself left Bolas trapped on the island

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Test of Metal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret captures Jace and has Baltrice torture him.

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana neutralizes Baltrice; Jace walks away from the ruined Consortium, refusing its secrets.
timeline.quote: Jace walked away from the ruins of the Consortium

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret's Infinite Consortium comes to Kamigawa; Baltrice burns Nashi's village, killing his parents and scarring him.
timeline.quote: Nashi's parents died in the process and he was left heavily scarred by a fire elemental controlled by Baltrice.

citation.text: "Nashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels across planes already overrun by Phyrexians, finding Baltrice's safehouses compromised.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn's "great work" was unfolding faster than Tezzeret could have imagined.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret finds Baltrice's safehouse behind a gaming parlor and gathers supplies.
timeline.quote: Inside, he found exactly what he was looking for.

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.
